theme.vibe: MT5 Institutional Dark Terminal / High-Density Quantitative Gold Trading Platform

typography.pairing_rationale: High-density institutional trading desk style. JetBrains Mono across headlines, metrics, order books, and indicators ensures pristine tabular alignment (tnum), mechanical precision, and fast scanning without cognitive fatigue.

entry_surfaces./: Institutional MT5-inspired Gold (XAUUSDT) Futures Trading Terminal with top market ticker bar, main multi-timeframe candlestick chart, signal matrix, wallet/active trade stats, and trade history blotter.

grids.desktop_layout: grid grid-cols-12 gap-3 p-3 bg-[#0b0e14] min-h-screen

spans.top_ticker_bar: col-span-12 h-14 bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between
spans.main_chart: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 row-span-2 min-h-[520px] bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-md p-4 flex flex-col
spans.signal_engine: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-md p-4 space-y-4
spans.wallet_and_active_trade: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-md p-4 space-y-4
spans.trade_history_blotter: col-span-12 bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-md p-4 space-y-3

layouts.header_nav: Sticky dark terminal bar (`bg-[#111827]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between z-50`) featuring XAUUSDT asset icon, live WebSocket ping indicator, timeframe selector (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h), and paper wallet equity counter.
layouts.chart_section: Customized Recharts ComposedChart with candlestick representation (or high/low/close area + bar overlay), moving averages (EMA 20/50), VWAP, Bollinger Bands, and dynamic ReferenceLine markers for Entry (Cyan), SL (Red), and TP (Green).
layouts.signal_panel: Confidence Dial / Progress Radial Meter showing signal status (BUY / SELL / WAIT) with confidence % (e.g., 88%). Includes collapsible multi-indicator checklist (EMA trend, RSI momentum, MACD cross, Bollinger Squeeze, ATR Volatility, ADX Strength, VWAP bias, S/R Levels, Market Structure).
layouts.active_trade_card: Real-time P&L status badge with live ticking profit, position size, leverage, entry price, dynamic Trailing Stop bar, auto-timeout timer, and manual Close Trade button.
layouts.trade_history_table: Dense MT5 trade log table with columns for Trade ID, Direction, Entry/Exit, P&L ($ / %), Duration, Confidence Score, and Expandable Explanation Drawer explaining reason for entry, SL/TP calculation logic, and exit trigger.

motion.micro_interactions: Smooth 150ms hover glow on interactive controls, 300ms flash highlights on live price updates, crisp tab transitions for timeframe switching.
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: All transitions wrap with `motion-reduce:transition-none` and `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks to avoid visual clutter.
motion.live_tick_flash: Animate subtle background pulse (`bg-emerald-500/10` or `bg-rose-500/10`) for 500ms whenever WebSocket tick updates XAUUSDT price.

accessibility.contrast: All text tokens pass APCA and WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum against their respective dark panel backgrounds.
accessibility.data_test_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive controls, price tickers, signal indicators, timeframe buttons, and trade log rows.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Visible focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:outline-none`) on all timeframe buttons and trade action triggers.

3d_libraries.charts_implementation: Recharts (preinstalled) custom responsive ComposedChart for candlestick & indicator layer, AreaChart for RSI/MACD/ADX sub-charts, and RadialBarChart / PieChart for Signal Confidence dial.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font import in `/app/frontend/src/index.css` with `@import '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono';` and set `--font-sans: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace;` and `--font-heading: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace;`.
2. Ensure dark mode is active by setting `<html class="dark">` in `frontend/index.html`.

3. Build a robust backend paper trading engine in FastAPI (`backend/routers/` or `backend/server.py`) that fetches live Binance XAUUSDT Futures klines/ticks via WebSocket or REST fallback, calculates multi-indicator confirmations (EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, VWAP, S/R), generates signals with confidence scores, auto-opens paper trades when confidence >= 80%, manages SL/TP, trailing stop, trade timeout, and detailed trade rationale logs.

4. Construct the frontend dashboard using a dense MT5 terminal layout with top ticker bar, timeframe buttons (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h), dynamic Recharts candlestick view with Entry/SL/TP ReferenceLines, Signal Radar card, Paper Wallet Summary card, Active Trade card, and expandable Trade History table.

5. Every key interactive element and metric MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. `data-testid="timeframe-1m-button"`, `data-testid="live-price-ticker"`, `data-testid="signal-confidence-score"`, `data-testid="active-trade-card"`, `data-testid="trade-history-row"`).
6. Do NOT use center-aligned global body styles or full-screen generic gradients. Keep borders clean with `border-slate-800` and crisp 1px hairlines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: build high-density, rich institutional interfaces that resemble MT5 / Bloomberg Terminal.
Do NOT use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮) as icons. Use Lucide icons (e.g. `TrendingUp`, `TrendingDown`, `ShieldAlert`, `Clock`, `Activity`, `Wallet`).
Always specify explicit transitions for interactive states (e.g. `transition-colors duration-150`), avoiding global `transition: all`.
Use generous padding inside bordered containers (`p-4` to `p-6`) to prevent text and chart edge collision.
Ensure all toast notifications utilize `sonner` (`import { toast } from 'sonner'`).
